meta.name: Chememan Design System
meta.note: tokens.json is THE authoritative machine-readable source. tokens.css is hand-mirrored from this file (light/dark literal values); tokens.pptx.json mirrors the same colors for non-web use. tokens/tailwind.preset.js does NOT duplicate literal values — it forwards var(--cman-*) references straight to tokens.css, so light/dark switching (the app's [data-theme] attribute) keeps working through Tailwind classes with nothing to keep in sync.
meta.source: jakkaritw's approved 2026-08-15 theme for the Chememan Budget Management web app (c:\04.budget_management_web, frontend/src/styles/tokens.css + global.css) — NOT an extraction from sc-qas.chememan.com. Provenance chain: design/mockups/theme-shell-green-handoff-prompt.md (decision record), design/mockups/theme-shell-green-contrast.py (WCAG math), frontend/src/styles/global.css (real call sites for type/radius/spacing).
meta.supersedes: This repo previously carried a live-Supply-Chain-app system and, before that, a CI-book/glassmorphism system. Both are fully retired as of this rebuild — this repo now carries exactly ONE style. Retired values are visible in git history before this commit only.
meta.scope: Chememan Budget Management web app — page shell, cards, buttons, status pills, data grid, forms, badges/chips

color._note: Every color has a light and dark value (dark = resolved, alias chains already followed — see tokens.css for the actual [data-theme='dark'] override rules). shell and green hold the SAME value in light theme (the shell IS the primary accent there) but diverge in dark theme (near-black shell + a separate lighter-green accent) — see tokens.css header comment.

green.role: Brand accent — primary button fill, links, focus

ink-on-shell.role: Text painted directly on the shell, no card ancestor. 4.25:1 on the light shell — the accepted AA ceiling, see meta.

ink-on-shell-2.role: Muted on-shell text. Light theme COLLAPSES this to white (#c6c0b2 measured 2.34:1, fails).

accent-on-shell.role: Accent text on the shell. Light theme's old gold #d4ac52 RETIRED (measured 1.99:1, fails at any size).

line-on-shell.role: Hairline drawn directly on the shell

surface-inset.role: Card surface, secondary / inset (nested panels, thead, subtotal rows)

accent-text.role: Brand accent used as TEXT on a light/dark card — a different role from accent-on-shell; one color cannot satisfy both backgrounds.

pending.role: Pending (editable) layer — reuses plain ink, no dedicated hue

focus-ring.role: Keyboard focus outline — aliases accent-text; shell-hosted containers with no card ancestor repoint to accent-on-shell locally

font._note: Bootstrap 5.3.2's own default system stack. The source app loads no custom webfont — this design system ships none either (FC Minimal retired with this rebuild).

sans.value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

serif.role: No serif face shipped — collapses to sans, same as the source app

mono.value: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

size._note: Every font-size actually used across frontend/src/styles/global.css, smallest to largest — do not add a size the app does not use.

lg2.use: month-col th-label — same size as base body text

tracking._note: A curated sample of the real letter-spacing values in global.css, not an exhaustive list of every literal decimal used.

radius._note: 6px is the app's single base radius (--r in the source app); the other 3 values are the only other border-radius literals global.css uses.

spacing._note: A curated 4px-based scale from the padding/gap values that recur most across global.css. One-off bespoke gaps (13px, 18px, 22px, 30px) are left as component-specific, not promoted to the scale.
